name: Twisted Murderer
desc:
A Murder Mystery, but much more TWISTED featuring "SPECIAL ROUNDS"
🔪Murder Madness: everyone is the murderer
🤠Sheriff Showdown: everyone is the sheriff
💀Double Trouble: 2 murderers and 2 sheriffs
💪Juggernaut: 1 murderer vs ALL sheriffs
🥍Sticks and Stones: Murderers VS Sheriffs
🔫One In The Chamber: you have one bullet
🧟Infected: Zombies must infect all sheriffs

Each classic round, you will receive one of the roles:
🧍 Innocent: run from the murderer
🤠 Sheriff: take down the murderer
🔪 Murderer: eliminate EVERYONE

Please 👍 and ⭐️ the game if you want more updates!
